_comment: Dependency license policy (Mission 12), used by scripts/licenses.mjs check. 'allowed' lists SPDX identifiers that a dependency's license expression may be satisfied with: permissive licenses, file-level copyleft (MPL-2.0), the font license (OFL-1.1) and permissive data licenses. Strong copyleft (GPL, AGPL, LGPL as the only option), source-available (Commons Clause, BUSL, SSPL) and proprietary licenses are not allowed without a reviewed exception. Changing this list or adding an exception needs a maintainer's review; see docs/governance/THIRD_PARTY_LICENSE_AUDIT.md.
